title: The elder's ledger hints early on that 'the first reeve's name is written there, and then crossed out' — a strong, specific clue toward the endgame reveal that the first Reeve stole the crown — but no later dialogue (the steward's shade, the Hollow King, or the first Reeve's shade himself) ever explicitly calls back to that ledger, so the payoff lands only if the player remembers the throwaway line from hours before.
